issues.description: The task text in problem_statement.md (line 118) asks for zoos in the municipality with gemeindeschluessel '09162000', but the reference solution filters WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162001' (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql line 3). This mismatch between the municipality identifier in the problem description and the solution will confuse students and can cause correctly written queries that use '09162000' to be marked incorrect by the automatic checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the municipality key consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to request gemeindeschluessel = '09162001' if that is the intended test key, or update the reference solution (and any tests/expected-result files) to use '09162000'. Ensure the automated tests and example solution use the same gemeindeschluessel value so student submissions are graded against the intended municipality.
